market_wrap.text: Nifty rose 0.38% to 25,387 as banks led (Bank Nifty hit a record high), helped by easing crude oil and foreign fund inflows; IT fell 0.9% on a global tech sell-off. Your portfolio fell 0.93% for the day once fund NAVs came in, mainly because the three silver funds reported Monday's sharp silver fall.

reasons.reason: These fund-of-funds report with a one-day lag, so today's NAVs carry Monday's (16 Nov) silver slide: MCX silver fell over 3% to a one-year low as markets priced in a likely US Fed rate rise in December and the dollar firmed. The silver ETF you hold directly was flat today.
No company announcement or news found today. The rise was well above the market's, so it was likely stock-specific buying; its last results (27 Oct) showed revenue up 29.9%.
No company news found today. The stock has been volatile: on 5 Nov the exchange asked the company about unusual trading volume, and it said there was no undisclosed information behind it.
No company news today. Its September-quarter results (14 Nov) showed revenue up 1.6% from the previous quarter but profit down 9%, which may still be weighing on the thinly traded stock.

news.headline: September-quarter profit falls 95%
news.summary: Net profit dropped to ₹5.9 crore from ₹128.5 crore a year earlier and income slipped 3% to ₹1,091 crore; higher depreciation and finance costs squeezed earnings.

news.headline: First results as a listed company: profit down 9% on the quarter
news.summary: Revenue rose 1.6% from the June quarter to ₹154 crore, but operating profit fell 13% and net profit 9% to ₹17.4 crore.

news.headline: Silver hits a one-year low on Fed rate-rise bets
news.summary: MCX silver fell more than 3% on Monday as markets priced a high chance of a December US rate rise; gold also slipped to multi-month lows.

events.detail: Meeting runs 2–4 December. The RBI raised rates in October; another rise would weigh on your bond fund and on small and mid caps.
Meeting runs 8–9 December; markets expect a rate rise, the main pressure on silver and gold lately.
events.affects: Silver and gold funds (about 30% of the portfolio)

events.detail: Companies usually report from mid-January to mid-February; results moved Manorama, Hindustan Copper and KRN this quarter.

outlook.view: Silver is at a one-year low, far below its peak, as expected US rate rises and a firm dollar outweigh steady industrial demand from solar panels and electronics.
outlook.watch: US Fed decision on 9 December and the dollar.

outlook.view: They led today and have outperformed large caps this year, but they fall harder when rates rise or foreign investors sell.
outlook.watch: RBI decision on 4 December and foreign investor flows.

outlook.view: AI demand is lifting hardware makers like Netweb, but a global sell-off in AI stocks hit Indian IT today (Nifty IT −0.9%).
Record copper prices drove Hindustan Copper's profit surge; its earnings move closely with the copper price.
outlook.watch: Global copper prices and the mining expansion.

outlook.view: The RBI is in a tightening phase, which tends to lower bond prices in the short term and raise yields on new bonds.
